Investiture: The underlying magical substance of the Cosmere. Every magic system is Investiture expressed through a Shard's intent.
Shard: A sixteenth of the power of Adonalsium, bonded to a mortal who takes on the intent (Preservation, Ruin, Honor, etc.).
Allomancy: Mistborn metal-ingesting magic — 16 metals, each with a specific power.
Hemalurgy: Stealing abilities via spikes driven into the heart of another; each spike steals a specific attribute.
Feruchemy: Storing attributes in metal to retrieve later; genetic, recessive.
Stormlight: Stored light from highstorms, powering Surgebinding on Roshar.
Surgebinding: Magic of the Knights Radiant, granted by oaths sworn to spren.
Spren: Fragments of divine identity on Roshar, capable of bonding with humans to form Radiants.
Breath: The animating force of Awakening on Nalthis; color-hungry.
AonDor: Elantrian magic — drawing symbolic aons that shape reality.
Three Laws: Sanderson's three laws of magic; the craft-level framework for hard systems.
Avalanche: Sanderson's term for the cascading resolution in the final 20% of a book.
Promise-Progress-Payoff: Three-beat structural test for every arc and every scene.
Hard magic: Systems where the reader can predict outcomes because rules are known.
Soft magic: Systems where the reader feels wonder but cannot predict; used for awe, not problem-solving.
Sel: The planet of Elantris. One of many in the Cosmere.
Scadrial: The planet of Mistborn — both original trilogy and Wax and Wayne.
Roshar: The planet of the Stormlight Archive. Storm-battered, crustacean ecology.
Nalthis: The planet of Warbreaker. Hub of Breath and Awakening.
Cosmere: The shared universe. Every Shardworld is a node.
